title: Define hosted revision details
responsibility: Defines the accepted structure of a revision’s registry, comparisons, records and explanations.

outputs.name: hostedEvidenceDetail
outputs.description: A strict Zod object schema for one hosted revision detail: a 40-character lowercase hex commit, the unit registry and graph, a nullable comparison, an optional nullable source impact, an optional nullable side string, verification records, explanations, an optional range-reason count and optional regression proofs. Hosted evidence answers check each side's detail against it, so a side's detail must match it or be null; the schema reads nothing itself, rejects undeclared keys in every object it defines, and caps its own text at 1,000,000 characters, names at 1 to 300 characters and arrays at 5,000 items, while regression proofs keep their own schema. The exported value is the runtime schema instance, so accepted detail records are not output-instance examples.
